HOW WE LEARN

Reading, demonstration, practice and continuous review

The learning of Essence Therapy proceeds from concept to experience: reading books and public articles, understanding body feelings and inner space; watching demonstrations in workshops, participating in exercises, and continuing to practice and review after class.

Different courses have their own focus. The first level establishes the foundation, dreamwork uses dreams as the entrance, and the second level deepens the method based on existing learning experience.
